text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hello, I am Mejiro Bright. I do things a 
bit leisurely, though~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best and keep striving to catch 
up with the Mejiro ladies ahead of me~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready for strict training~, so please 
take good care of me♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
